data.reason: They name the same crux in different words: a present left materially and psychologically unredeemed, made bearable only from an unmarked, undecidable retrospect in which it is already past. Option 1's second point about the two time-registers and the storm's circular return is Option 0's structural evidence made explicit — the frame that shows only her distance has moved — not a different crux, and Option 1 gives that sameness in more checkable English directives (unmarked slide, unresolved conjectures, repeated words, flat domestic exchanges). Option 0 got the husband-warning right — neither antagonist nor rescuer — but the text that goes forward is Option 1 as written.
data.say:
Pick: Option 1. They name the same crux — consolation only in retrospect, the present untouched — and Option 1's time-and-storm point is Option 0's frame made explicit, not a second crux.
